summary: folder-lint preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: folder-lint@1.0.15 declares a preinstall hook (`scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the detected platform, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled CommonJS bundle with a shuffled string-array decoder and hex-suffixed identifiers, unrelated to the advertised functionality of the package (a small folder-schema linter whose actual library code lives in `lib/*.js`). The Bun runtime is fetched only to execute this opaque payload, whose behavior cannot be inspected without deobfuscation. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: pulling a second language runtime at install time solely to execute a bundled obfuscated payload bypasses scanners that trace only Node-resolved code, and every installer runs the payload under Bun before the package is even usable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
